name: The Kami War
description: The war begun when kami set upon Reito, lasting twenty years as spirits ravaged the plains.

description_citations.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The town of Reito is destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

citation.text: Ghostly Prison (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spirits of weapons turn against great warriors in the first days of the war.
timeline.quote: Many great warriors died in the first days of the war

citation.text: Kabuto Moth (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Strain on the veil begins to show near the end of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War.

citation.text: Aether Shockwave (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The kami set upon the town of Reito, killing nearly every living thing, and the Kami War begins.
timeline.quote: A few miles from Eiganjo Castle, the kami set upon the town of Reito.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: War in which the kami turned against mortals across Kamigawa.
